national_law.name: Netz- und Informationssystemsicherheitsgesetz 2026
national_law.entry_into_force_note: Passed by Nationalrat on December 12, 2025 with two-thirds majority. Previous attempt (NISG 2024) was rejected on July 3, 2024.

management_liability.description: Management board retains personal accountability for cybersecurity. Non-compliance can result in temporary disqualification from management functions. Training required for management and employees.

penalties.essential_entities: EUR 10,000,000 or 2% of worldwide annual turnover
penalties.important_entities: EUR 7,000,000 or 1.4% of worldwide annual turnover

sources.title: WKO - NISG 2026 neue Pflichten zur Cybersicherheit

notes: Previous NISG 2024 was rejected by Nationalrat on July 3, 2024
NISG 2026 required two-thirds majority to pass
Entry into force delayed to October 1, 2026
Austria among few EU nations that initially faced rejection of NIS2 transposition
